text: うん…　つれて　いける　ポケモンは　６ひき　までだ

structure.jp: つれて　いける　ポケモンは
structure.en: the Pokémon you can take along

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: A て form followed by いく adds 'and go': doing something as you go away from here. つれて　いける = 'can take along'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing いく to いける adds the meaning 'can'. いける = 'can go'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つれて　いける　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. つれて　いける　ポケモン = 'Pokémon you can take along'.
